name: Cryonic-Mausoleum

civilization.name: Ysolde Dominion
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: Dust finer than flour pools in the low places, swallowing craters to their rims. Nothing has disturbed impact-scarred wastelands in a million years, and the dust keeps its surface smooth as held breath.
There is a hush that is not emptiness but attention, as if the landscape were listening back. Visitors report dreams of falling that persist for days after departure.
Around the exotic matter deposit, reality bends in small ways. Compasses sulk, clocks gain seconds, and long-stay crews develop identical tics.
There is money in uranium here, and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
